bullets.text: Anbumani Ramadoss warned that building a boundary wall in the Pallikaranai wetland will cause a disaster and block water flow.
The office should closely watch the public road roko protests and water flow grievances raised by Pallikaranai residents to the PMK leader.
The state highways department is desilting and clearing three culverts along Jawaharlal Nehru Salai to flood-proof Velachery before the monsoon.
The Madras High Court heard the case regarding NGT's ban on construction within a one-kilometer radius of the Pallikaranai wetland.
Police arrested a maid and her lover for stealing 10 sovereigns of gold from Dr. Karthik's residence in Kovilambakkam, Velachery.
TANGEDCO announced a five-hour power shutdown for maintenance affecting areas like Ambattur, Tambaram, and Avadi on Sunday.
Poonamallee residents suffered due to frequent nighttime power outages, prompting local complaints and public attention.
MGNREGS workers in Tiruttani staged a protest and besieged the BDO office over low wage payments.
R Kirlosh Kumar announced that Tamil Nadu will introduce SPEED, an AI-based planning approval software to expedite developments.
Tamil Nadu is experiencing renewed growth and expansion in its Global Capability Centre sector across multiple cities.
Henox IT and Data Centers launched the Crest coastal submarine cable system to support growing AI connectivity in India.
Youth Congress members were arrested in Chennai after releasing black balloons during the Poonamallee-Vadapalani metro launch event.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss strongly criticized TVK for continuing DMK's past actions regarding the Pallikaranai wetland issue.
TVK MLA ECR Saravanan approached the Madras High Court to quash an FIR registered against him in an unauthorized banners case.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched and laid foundation stones for development projects worth over Rs 13,000 crore in Chennai.
Prime Minister Modi pledged the Centre's continued support to work with Tamil Nadu and accelerate the state's development.
